_about: ACME-USDC: proxy (shadow) of USDC held on Base (program `stables`, standard PROXY-FT). Created with /v1/token/add proxy branch (chainId, contractAddress, walletAddress, value). contractAddress in token/add must equal metadata.contractIds[chainId]. Prefer the SEEDED `USDC` class: its STORED identities are [] so any authenticated user can import their own wallet. On register, `identities: []` behaves like omitted (you become owner+issuer); to open your own proxy class to all users, set it afterwards with /v1/tokenclass/update {tokenClass, identities: []} (verify on your instance).

register.name: USD Coin (ACME proxy)
register.description: Shadow balance of USDC held in users' own wallets on Base mainnet and Base Sepolia.
